Select activity_id, molecule_dictionary.chembl_id as molecule_chembl_id, target_dictionary.chembl_id as target_chembl_id, target_dictionary.pref_name as target_name, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units. Join activities with molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno. Join assays on activities.assay_id. Join target_dictionary on assays.tid. Filter where target_dictionary.organism equals 'Homo sapiens', target_dictionary.target_type equals 'SINGLE PROTEIN', standard_units equals 'nM', standard_type in ('EC50', 'IC50', 'AC50'), and standard_value is less than 50. Sort by activity_id ascending. Return the first 200 rows.
